About

Ideas should survive
outside the screen.

I began around commercial print production, where I learned that design is only finished when it works in the real world. Since 2017, I’ve built an independent practice across music, events, local business, Web3, video, and merchandise.

My strength is seeing the gap between what a brand is and what it could become—then building the visual system to close it.
